description: Curated list of well-known Swiss National Bank data-portal cube ids (FX rates, money market rates incl. SARON, Confederation bond yields, SNB balance sheet, monetary aggregates, CPI, effective exchange rates) with frequency and a confidence flag for each id. Optional keyword filter, e.g. 'saron', 'bond yield', 'balance sheet', 'M3'. Then call get_snb_cube_dimensions or get_snb_data with the cube_id. Any other cube id from data.snb.ch also works with those tools.
name: list_snb_datasets
title: List well-known SNB data cubes
